investigations.title: DB connection pool misconfiguration (payment-service v1.8.2)
investigations.root_cause: Database connection pool misconfiguration introduced by a recent change to payment-service (v1.8.2, DB_POOL_SIZE 20 -> 2) causes connection timeouts and HTTP 500s.

checks.name: root_cause_identified
checks.detail: Database connection pool misconfiguration introduced by a recent change to payment-service (v1.8.2, DB_POOL_SIZE 20 -> 2) causes connection timeouts and HTTP 500s.

investigations.title: Memory leak -> OOM restarts (order-service)
investigations.root_cause: Memory leak in order-service causes OutOfMemoryError and repeated container restarts (OOMKilled) (v2.3.0).

checks.name: root_cause_identified
checks.detail: Memory leak in order-service causes OutOfMemoryError and repeated container restarts (OOMKilled) (v2.3.0).

investigations.title: Slow downstream dependency (inventory-service -> order-service)
investigations.root_cause: Slow downstream dependency inventory-service causes order-service upstream timeouts.

checks.name: root_cause_identified
checks.detail: Slow downstream dependency inventory-service causes order-service upstream timeouts.

investigations.title: Bad deployment (user-service image cannot be pulled)
investigations.root_cause: user-service deployment (v3.2.0) references an image tag that cannot be pulled (ImagePullBackOff), leaving it with fewer ready replicas.

checks.name: root_cause_identified
checks.detail: user-service deployment (v3.2.0) references an image tag that cannot be pulled (ImagePullBackOff), leaving it with fewer ready replicas.

investigations.title: Cache outage (Redis down)
investigations.root_cause: Cache outage (redis) forces fallback to the database, increasing latency for payment-service and every service that uses the cache.
